title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors of downtown Potsdam that serve as the primary off-campus social and commercial hub for Clarkson University students.

cards.title: The Downtown Social Hub
cards.subtitle: Market Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this primary commercial block to find student favorites like Sergi's Italian Restaurant and various local boutiques in the heart of the village.
cards.short_summary: Market Street is the central commercial corridor of downtown Potsdam, hosting numerous restaurants and shops popular with the Clarkson community.
cards.evidence_claim: Market Street is the site of the annual 'First Saturday' event which welcomes Clarkson and SUNY Potsdam students to the community with live music and discounts.
cards.source_title: First Saturday: Welcome Students | Potsdam Chamber of Commerce
cards.access_notes: Public village street accessible 24/7; business hours vary.

cards.title: Local Food and Co-op Finds
cards.subtitle: Elm Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this block for the Potsdam Food Co-op and popular eateries like Burrito Bob's, located just steps from the Raquette River bridge.
cards.short_summary: Elm Street connects the downtown core to the river and features a mix of specialty food markets and student-friendly dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Potsdam Food Co-op is located at 24 Elm Street and provides local, organic food options to the community and students.
cards.access_notes: Public street; Co-op open daily until 8 PM (Mon-Sat) and 5 PM (Sun).

cards.title: The Historic Gateway
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore the historic architecture and local services along this major thoroughfare that links the Clarkson campus to the village center.
cards.short_summary: Main Street serves as a primary artery for Potsdam, featuring historic buildings and essential services used by students and residents alike.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Street is a key corridor in the Village of Potsdam, housing the Potsdam Public Museum and providing access to Ives Park.

cards.title: Riverside Recreation
cards.subtitle: Fall Island District
cards.notes: Cross the bridge to this island park for community festivals, river views, and a unique natural setting in the middle of the Raquette River.
cards.short_summary: Fall Island is a distinct geographic district in the Raquette River that hosts community events and provides scenic recreational space.
cards.evidence_claim: Fall Island hosts the annual Fall Island Fiesta, a community event featuring family-friendly activities and local vendors.
cards.source_title: Many kids events planned at Fall Island Fiesta - North Country Now
cards.access_notes: Public park area; accessible during daylight hours.

cards.title: The Arts District
cards.subtitle: Raymond Street Corridor
cards.notes: Discover the local arts scene at the Creative Spirit Community Arts Center, which offers workshops and gallery space for students and locals.
cards.short_summary: Raymond Street is home to the SLC Arts Council and the Creative Spirit Community Arts Center, serving as a hub for local creativity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Creative Spirit Community Arts Center is located at 6-8 Raymond Street and provides art studios and gallery space.
cards.access_notes: Public street; Arts Center open Tuesday-Saturday with varying hours.

cards.title: The Commercial Connector
cards.subtitle: Maple Street Corridor
cards.notes: Find essential retail and pharmacy services like Kinney Drugs on this busy corridor that connects downtown to the northern village limits.
cards.short_summary: Maple Street (Route 11) is a major commercial thoroughfare featuring essential services and retail outlets for the student population.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clarkson Graduate Student Association lists Kinney Drugs on Maple Street as a primary pharmacy resource for students.
cards.source_title: Grocery and Pharmacy – Clarkson University Graduate Student Association

cards.title: The Village Green
cards.subtitle: Ives Park District
cards.notes: Relax at this riverside park featuring a gazebo, walking paths, and a canoe launch, located just behind the downtown commercial buildings.
cards.short_summary: Ives Park is a central green space on the Raquette River used for community gatherings, farmers markets, and student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Ives Park features a public canoe launch and hosts the Potsdam Farmer's Market on Saturday mornings.
cards.access_notes: Public park; open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: The Collegiate Corridor
cards.subtitle: Pierrepont Avenue District
cards.notes: Walk this scenic avenue to see historic homes and reach the SUNY Potsdam campus, which shares many resources with Clarkson students.
cards.short_summary: Pierrepont Avenue is a residential and institutional corridor that links the two major university areas in Potsdam.
cards.evidence_claim: Pierrepont Avenue is the primary address for SUNY Potsdam and serves as a major pedestrian link between the campuses.

cards.title: The Campus Entryway
cards.subtitle: Clarkson Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: This street serves as the formal entrance to the Clarkson University campus and is lined with university-affiliated buildings and offices.
cards.short_summary: Clarkson Avenue is the main gateway to the university, connecting the village streets to the core academic and residential hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clarkson University main campus is officially addressed at 8 Clarkson Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Public street and university entrance; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: The Market Square
cards.subtitle: Depot Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this block for the Market Square Mall and unique local businesses like the Third Wheel Pottery Studio and the Village Diner.
cards.short_summary: Depot Street features a mix of converted commercial spaces and local businesses that offer unique services to the Potsdam community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Third Wheel Pottery Studio and the Village Diner are located on Depot Street within the Market Square Mall area.
cards.source_title: The Third Wheel Pottery Studio - Potsdam Chamber of Commerce
